description: This source file defines React hooks and utility functions for implementing and managing progressive batch processing within React applications. It provides a non-React controller 'createProgressiveExpandController' to perform batched work over time (using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout fallback), along with a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' to integrate this functionality with React component state for tracking progress, running status, and handling cancellations.
